headline: Review: 3 config-class findings across 4 devices; top is WAN-04 BGP neighbors idle because the neighbor stanza lacks the address-family activation WAN-02 carries
next_action: Apply review[1] only with explicit authorization

finding.headline: WAN-04 router bgp has two neighbors with no 'neighbor <ip> activate' under address-family ipv4; WAN-02 (established peers) carries the line for each neighbor

change.summary: ensure_present 'neighbor 100.64.7.2 activate' and 'neighbor 100.64.8.2 activate' under router bgp 65000 / address-family ipv4 on WAN-04; nothing else touched

review.finding: Two WAN-04 bgp rows idle on the board; git shows the neighbors defined but not activated under address-family ipv4, unlike WAN-02 where every neighbor has 'activate'
review.proposed: ensure_present 'neighbor 100.64.7.2 activate' and 'neighbor 100.64.8.2 activate' under router bgp 65000 / address-family ipv4 on WAN-04, after the matching 'neighbor <ip> remote-as' lines

review.finding: Board shows input_acl BLOCK-PING-SPLUNK bound on GigabitEthernet5; git on dev has no such ACL or binding — the box carries an uncommitted change
GigabitEthernet2 oper up with clean counters while the branch is reported down; git shows AI-BRANCH-01 lacks the 'ip helper-address' AI-BRANCH-02 carries on its LAN interface
review.proposed: ensure_present 'ip helper-address 10.40.40.11' under interface GigabitEthernet2 on AI-BRANCH-01, after 'ip address'

review.finding: Nine administrator config commits via vty in the window with no change row on the ServiceNow board; git cannot say what changed on the box
